blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Document-level text simplification involves transformations that go beyond sentence-internal edits, addressing discourse coherence, anaphora resolution, and cross-paragraph consistency. Despite advances in sentence-level simplification for high-resource languages, document-level simplification in morphologically rich, low-resource languages such as Estonian remains largely unexplored. This study presents a comprehensive evaluation of five state-of-the-art multilingual large language models (LLMs) for document-level simplification in Estonian. Three prompting strategies are examined: single-pass generation, pipeline-based modular agents, and guideline-augmented pipelines. The evaluation framework integrates automatic metrics assessing readability, semantic preservation, and discourse coherence, alongside a structured manual annotation protocol. The findings indicate that Gemini-2.0 and LLaMA-3.3 produce outputs with near-native fluency and strong meaning preservation, whereas other models display notable grammatical and semantic limitations. This work contributes novel document-level coherence metrics, evidence-based prompting strategies, and publicly available resources for reproducibility.
blocks.zh: 文件层面的文本简化涉及超越句子内部编辑的转换,涉及话语一致性,aaphora解析和跨段落一致性. 尽管在高资源语言的句子层面简化方面取得了进展,但爱沙尼亚等资源水平低的形态语言的文件层面简化仍然基本上没有得到探讨。 这项研究对爱沙尼亚用于文件一级简化的五个最先进的多语种大语言模式进行了全面评估。 审查了三个促进性战略:单一通道生成、以管道为基础的模块化剂和以准则强化的管道。 评价框架结合了评估可读性、语义保存和话语一致性的自动衡量标准,以及结构化的人工注释协议。 调查结果表明,双子座2.0和LLaMA-3.3产出近乎本土流利并具有强烈意义保存,而其他模型则显示出显著的语法和语义限制. 这项工作提供了新的文件一级一致性指标、循证激励战略以及可复制的公开资源。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Text simplification aims to reduce linguistic complexity while preserving the original meaning of a text. This task improves access to information for language learners, individuals with cognitive impairments, and broader audiences seeking clarity Alva-Manchego et al. (2020) . Traditional research has focused on sentence-level simplification, involving transformations such as lexical substitution, syntactic restructuring, and sentence shortening Zhang and Lapata (2017) . These operations are vital for real-world use cases, including education, public communication, and assistive technologies Gala and Wilkens (2020) ; Barbu et al. (2015) .
blocks.zh: 文本简化旨在降低语言复杂性,同时保留文本的原始含义. 这项任务改善了语言学习者、认知障碍者以及寻求清晰度的更广泛的受众获得信息的机会(2020年)。 传统研究侧重于句子层面的简化,涉及词汇替代,合成重组等转型,并缩短了张和拉帕塔(2017年). 这些行动对现实世界的使用案例至关重要,包括教育、公共传播和辅助技术Gala和Wilkens(2020年);Barbu等(2015年)。

blocks.en: Document-level simplification presents additional challenges. Beyond sentence-internal complexity, it involves discourse coherence, anaphora resolution, and consistent structural transformations across paragraphs Sun et al. (2021) . Sentence-by-sentence simplification can disrupt discourse structure and cohesion, potentially compromising comprehension Vasquez Rodriguez and others (2024) .
blocks.zh: 文件层面的简化带来了更多的挑战。 除了句子-内部复杂性之外,它还涉及语句的一致性、解答和段落间一致的结构转变 孙等. (2021) (中文(简体) ). 逐一判决的简化会破坏言论结构和凝聚力,可能损害对Vasquez Rodriguez和其他人(2024年)的理解。

blocks.en: This study addresses document-level simplification for Estonian, a morphologically rich and low-resource language. While large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in sentence-level simplification for English, their document-level capabilities in low-resource settings remain insufficiently explored. To address this gap, five state-of-the-art multilingual LLMs are evaluated on Estonian Wikipedia articles using three prompting strategies.

blocks.en: The remainder of this paper is structured as follows. Section 2 reviews prior work on document simplification. Section 3 motivates the selection of large language models, describes the document-level simplification operations, and presents the prompting strategies used in our experiments. Section 4 outlines the experimental setup, including model access, configuration, and evaluation data. Section 5 details both the automatic and manual evaluation procedures. Finally, the paper concludes with a summary of findings and a brief overview of the public repository containing the code and resources necessary to reproduce our experiments.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Automatic text simplification (ATS) Saggion (2017) ; Shardlow (2014) ; Espinosa-Zaragoza et al. (2023) has evolved from rule-based approaches to neural architectures and large-scale pretrained models. Early systems relied on handcrafted rules for lexical substitution and syntactic transformations Chandrasekar et al. (1996) , but scalability and domain adaptation posed challenges. Seq2Seq architectures improved fluency and structural variation, while reinforcement learning Zhang and Lapata (2017) and controllable models Maddela et al. (2021) introduced optimization over multiple simplification objectives, such as grammaticality and simplicity.
Pretrained Transformer models like T5 Raffel et al. (2020) and GPT variants OpenAI (2023) enabled zero- and few-shot simplification, though concerns persist regarding cost, reproducibility, and closed-source APIs.
blocks.zh:
自动文本简化 (ATS) Saggion (2017); Shardlow (2014); Espinosa-Zaragoza等 (2023) 已经由基于规则的方法演变为神经架构和大规模预训模型. 早期的系统依靠手制的替代法和合成转化规则Chandrasekar等人(1996年),但可扩展性和领域适应性提出了挑战。 Seq2Seq架构改善了流畅性和结构变异性,而强化学习张作霖和拉帕塔(2017年)和可控模型Maddela等(2021年)则引入了对多简化目标的优化,如语法和简洁.
T5 Raffel等人(2020年)和GPT等变体OpenAI(2023年)等经过预先培训的变形器模型实现了零发和零发的简化,尽管对成本、可再生性和闭源API的担忧依然存在。

blocks.en: While sentence-level simplification has dominated research, document-level simplification remains comparatively underexplored. Sun et al. (2021) introduced the D-Wikipedia dataset and proposed the D-SARI metric designed explicitly for evaluating document-level simplification, emphasizing the need to preserve discourse structure while simplifying. Fang and others (2025) proposed a progressive simplification method (ProgDS) that decomposes document simplification into hierarchical stages: discourse-level, topic-level, and lexical-level simplification, mimicking human editor workflows. Document-level simplification requires attention to coherence and cohesion Siddharthan (2006) ; Vasquez Rodriguez and others (2024) . For example, Siddharthan (2006) showed that syntactic simplification must preserve anaphoric and conjunctive cohesive relations to maintain text coherence, while recent work by Vasquez Rodriguez and others (2024) introduces SimDoc, a system that incorporates readability and coherence objectives during training, demonstrating the importance of multi-dimensional evaluation beyond simple lexical and syntactic measures.
blocks.zh: 虽然句子层面的简化在研究中占据了主导地位,但文件层面的简化仍然相对没有得到充分利用。 Sun等 (2021)引入了D-Wikipedia数据集,并提出了D-SARI度量衡,明确用于评价文件级别简化,强调在简化的同时需要保留论述结构. Fang等(2025年)提出了将文件简化分解为分级阶段的渐进简化方法(ProgDS):讨论层次,专题层次,和词汇层次的简化,模仿了人类编辑工作流程. 文件一级的简化需要注意一致性和凝聚力Siddharthan(2006年);Vasquez Rodriguez等(2024年)。 例如,Siddharthan(2006年)表明,综合简化必须保持动词和连通性的一致性关系,以保持文本的一致性,而Vasquez Rodriguez等(2024年)最近的工作则引入了SimDoc,这个系统在培训期间纳入了可读性和一致性目标,表明多维评价超越简单的词汇和综合措施的重要性.

blocks.en: Parallel to model development, corpora such as the PWKP dataset Zhu et al. (2010) , its later filtered version WikiSmall Zhang and Lapata (2017) along with TurkCorpus Xu et al. (2016) and Newsela Xu et al. (2015) , have supported supervised training and evaluation. However, simplification remains under-explored for low-resource languages. Ryan et al. (2023) introduced MultiSim, a multilingual benchmark covering 12 languages and over 1.7 million sentence pairs, demonstrating that multilingual training can enhance performance in non-English settings and enable cross-lingual transfer to low-resource languages. Despite this progress, Estonian is not among the languages included, highlighting a gap in current multilingual simplification resources. For Estonian specifically, existing work has focused on sentence-level transformations, including lexical substitution and template-based syntactic edits. Barbu et al. (2025) introduced new Estonian datasets and fine-tuned LLaMA models, showing that large language models outperform NMT-based approaches in grammaticality, readability, and meaning preservation. The challenges of adapting simplification systems to morphologically rich, low-resource languages have been documented for other Baltic languages like Lithuanian Mandravickaitė et al. (2024) .

(2025年)引入了爱沙尼亚新的数据集和微调LLaMA模型,表明大语言模型在语法,可读性和意义保存方面都超过了基于NMT的方法. 为其他波罗的海语言,如立陶宛曼德罗维奇凯特等(2024年),记录了使简化系统适应形态丰富、资源匮乏语言的挑战。

blocks.en:
This study builds on previous work by focusing on document-level simplification for Estonian and introducing both automatic, discourse-aware evaluation and human annotation. It implements a four-agent simplification framework, inspired by the role-based prompting strategy proposed by Fang et al. (2025) .
This research addresses a critical gap in simplification research for morphologically rich, low-resource languages.
blocks.zh:
这项研究以以前的工作为基础,侧重于爱沙尼亚的文件一级简化,并引入了自动的、有话语意识的评价和人的注释。 它在Fang et al.(2025)提出的基于角色的激励战略的启发下,实施了一个四代理简化框架.
这一研究解决了形态学上丰富,资源少的语言简化研究中的一个重大空白.

blocks.en: 3 Large Language Model Prompting Strategies for Document Simplification
blocks.zh: 3 文件简化大语文示范提示战略

blocks.en: This section outlines the LLMs used in our experiments and the prompting strategies designed to elicit high-quality document-level simplifications. We begin by motivating our selection of both proprietary and open-access instruction-tuned LLMs. Next, we identify and describe the core set of document-level simplification operations that inform both evaluation and prompt design. Finally, we present the prompting workflows developed to enhance coherence, adequacy, and user-centered simplification in Estonian.
blocks.zh: 本节概述了我们实验中使用的有限责任和激励战略,这些战略旨在简化高质量的文件。 我们首先鼓励我们选择专有和开放存取的指令调制LLMs。 其次,我们确定并描述一套为评价和及时设计提供参考的文件一级简化业务的核心。 最后,我们介绍了为增强爱沙尼亚语的一致性、充分性和以用户为中心的简化而开发的激励工作流程。

blocks.en: 3.1 Document-Level Simplification Operations
blocks.zh: 3.1 文件一级简化 业务

blocks.en: Document-level simplification requires structural transformations that extend beyond isolated sentence rewriting. Core operations include sentence joining , which fuses fragmented or related content to improve fluency; sentence reordering , which reorganizes discourse for logical progression; and sentence splitting , which breaks down syntactically complex sentences to ease comprehension. Other key operations are sentence deletion which removes non-essential or redundant information, and sentence addition , which introduces explanatory details to clarify difficult content. Finally, anaphora resolution Mitkov (2002) plays a critical role in maintaining referential coherence, especially when prior operations disrupt the original structure. These transformations form the basis of our prompting strategies and help make document-level simplification more effective.
blocks.zh: 文件层面的简化需要结构转型,超越了孤立的句子重写. 核心操作包括: 加入的句子,将零碎或相干的内容接合起来来提高流利度; 重排的句子,将语句重组为逻辑进取; 和 分句子,分解为策略上复杂的句子来方便理解. 其他关键操作是删除删除非必要或多余信息的句子,并添加句子,引入解释性细节来澄清困难的内容. 最后,Anaphora决议Mitkov(2002)在维持优惠一致性方面发挥关键作用,特别是在先前的行动扰乱了原有结构的情况下。 这些转变构成我们促进战略的基础,并有助于使文件一级的简化更加有效。

blocks.en: 3.2 Model Selection
blocks.zh: 3.2 模式选择

blocks.en: To investigate the effectiveness of LLMs for document-level text simplification in Estonian, five instruction-tuned models were selected based on their multilingual capabilities, accessibility, and performance in recent benchmarks. The models represent a spectrum of proprietary and open-access systems, varying in architecture size and geographic origin.

blocks.en: 3.3 Prompting Strategies
blocks.zh: 3.3 迅速战略

blocks.en: Three prompting strategies were used to help the models produce clear and readable document-level simplifications. Each one had a specific prompt tailored to the task. Examples are shown below, and all prompt templates can be found in the project repository (see Section 7 ).
blocks.zh: 采用了三个提示性战略,帮助模型产生清晰可读的文件级简化。 每一个都有一个适合这项任务的具体的快速。 下文举例说明,所有即时模板均可在项目存放处找到(见第7节)。

blocks.en: The instructions are provided within a single prompt, making the approach efficient but prone to generating outputs that closely resemble the original text, with only minimal simplification.
blocks.zh: 指示是在单一的提示内提供的,使该方法有效率,但容易产生与原文非常相近的产出,而且简化程度极低。

blocks.en: Prompt Example: Single-Pass Simplifier Instruction: As a text simplification writer, your task is to simplify the given document. The simplified document should retain the original information. Elaborate complex terms or replace them with simpler alternatives. You may simplify the text via document-level simplification operations: • Deleting Sentences: Remove non-crucial or repetitive information. • Joining Sentences: Merge adjacent fragments to improve fluency if deletion caused disfluency. • Splitting Sentences: Divide long or complex sentences into simpler ones. • Reordering Sentences: Improve logical flow by adjusting sentence order. Apply these only when necessary. Output: Provide only the simplified document in Estonian.
blocks.zh: 提示示例: 单页简化器 指令 : 作为一个文本简化写入器,你的任务是简化给定的文档. 简化后的文件应保留原始资料。 详细拟订复杂的术语或以更简单的替代品取而代之。 您可以通过文档级别的简化操作简化文本: • 删除句子 : 删除非关键或重复的信息。 • 加入判决: 合并相邻的碎片,如果删除造成不流畅,则提高流畅度。 • 分开判决: 将长句或复杂句子分为更简单的句子. · 重排句子:通过调整句子顺序来改进逻辑流. 仅在必要的时候适用。 产出:只提供爱沙尼亚语的简化文件。

blocks.en: Deleting Sentences: Remove non-crucial or repetitive information.
blocks.zh: 删除句子:删除非关键或重复的信息.

blocks.en: Joining Sentences: Merge adjacent fragments to improve fluency if deletion caused disfluency.
blocks.zh: 加入句子时 : 合并相邻的碎片,如果删除造成不流畅,则提高流畅度。

blocks.en: Splitting Sentences: Divide long or complex sentences into simpler ones.
blocks.zh: 分句:将长句或复杂句子分为更简单的句子.

blocks.en: Reordering Sentences: Improve logical flow by adjusting sentence order.
blocks.zh: 重排判决顺序 : 通过调整句子顺序来改进逻辑流.

blocks.en: Prompts are formulated to simulate the behavior of a domain-specific simplification agent (e.g., "You are a professional text simplifier working for Estonian public communication…"). This approach aims to improve task alignment and output consistency by encouraging goal-oriented model behavior. Two distinct strategies were developed to investigate the effectiveness of role-based prompting in document-level text simplification.
blocks.zh: 提示是用来模拟特定域简化代理的行为的(例如"你是一个为爱沙尼亚公共通信工作的专业文本简化器". 这种方法旨在通过鼓励以目标为导向的模式行为,来改进任务协调并改进产出一致性. 制定了两项不同的战略,以调查在文件一级简化文本方面促进基于作用的效力。

blocks.en: The Pipeline-Only strategy employs a sequential workflow consisting of three specialized agents: the Terminology Interpreter (TI), the Structural Simplifier (SS), and the Anaphora Agent (AA). The output produced by each agent serves as the input for the subsequent one, forming a stepwise refinement process. The final simplified text is generated by the Anaphora Agent.
blocks.zh: 管道-只使用一个相继的工作流程,由三个专门人员组成:名词口译员(TI)、结构简化员(SS)和Anaphora代理(AA)。 每种剂产生的出产作为后续剂的投入,形成分步完善的过程. 最后的简化文本由Anaphora Agent生成.

blocks.en: Prompt Example: Anaphora Agent Instruction: You are an anaphora agent reviewing a previously simplified Estonian document. Ensure all anaphors (e.g., pronouns and references) are coherent and correctly linked to their antecedents. Where necessary, elaborate or adjust unclear references. Remove redundant or repetitive content. If everything is already correct, make no changes. Output: Provide only the edited simplified document in Estonian.
blocks.zh: 提示示例 Anaphora 代理指令 : 你是一个麻醉剂 检查一个以前简化的爱沙尼亚文件。 确保所有无名词(如代名词和参考词)与它们的前作一致并正确相联. 必要时,拟订或调整不明确的参考资料。 删除冗余或重复的内容。 如果一切已经正确,就不要改变。 产出:只提供经编辑的爱沙尼亚语简化文件。

blocks.en: The Pipeline-Guideline (PG) strategy extends the basic pipeline by introducing an additional agent, the Project Director (PD), responsible for generating simplification guidelines. This agent operates at the outset of the process to establish clear objectives and stylistic constraints for the downstream agents. By providing these structured guidelines, the strategy aims to enhance the consistency, coherence, and goal alignment of the overall simplification workflow.
blocks.zh: 管道-指南(PG)战略扩展了基本管道,增加了一个代理,即项目主任(PD),负责制定简化准则。 这种剂在过程开始时运作,为下游剂确定明确的目标和结构限制. 通过提供这些结构化的指导方针,该战略旨在增强整个简化工作流程的一致性、一致性和目标一致性。

blocks.en: Prompt Example: Project Director Instruction: You are a project director and your task is to create guidelines in Estonian for simplifying Estonian documents. The guidelines aim is to aid subsequent agents in the simplification process. The guideline should be set up as follows: 1. Executive Summary: A brief overview of the document’s main points, arguments, and conclusions. 2. Terminology: A list of specialized terms, along with their definitions and contextual meanings. All uncommon words and specialized terms mentioned in the document should be explained. 3. Main Arguments and Evidence: An outline of the document’s main arguments and the key evidence or examples that support these arguments. 4. Cultural and Social Context: Information about the cultural, historical, or social context mentioned in the document, to be appropriately addressed during simplification. Output: Provide only the guidelines for Estonian document-level simplification.
blocks.zh: 提示示例: 项目主任 指令 : 您是项目负责人,您的任务是在爱沙尼亚为简化爱沙尼亚文件制定指导方针。 准则的目的是在简化过程中协助随后的代理人。 准则应如下: 1. 执行摘要:文件要点、论点和结论的简要概述。 2. 术语:专门术语清单及其定义和背景含义。 文件中提到的所有不寻常的词语和专门术语都应加以解释。 3. 主要论点和证据: 概述文件的主要论点和支持这些论点的关键证据或例子。 4. 文化和社会背景:关于文件中提到的文化、历史或社会背景的信息,将在简化过程中适当处理。 产出:只提供爱沙尼亚文件一级简化的准则。

blocks.en: The prompt templates were manually crafted and iteratively refined through pilot testing to optimize clarity, brevity, and alignment with the simplification task.
blocks.zh: 通过试点测试,对快速模板进行了人工设计和迭代改进,以优化清晰度、简洁度和与简化工作保持一致。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation Data
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价数据

blocks.en: A representative set of 15 articles was randomly selected from a filtered 4,000-article sample of Estonian Wikipedia. Articles were constrained to a length between 50 and 250 words to ensure sufficient linguistic variation while maintaining feasibility for human annotation. Reference simplifications were authored independently by a native Estonian linguist following structured annotation guidelines. These simplifications were created without exposure to model outputs to avoid bias in evaluation.
blocks.zh: 从爱沙尼亚维基百科被过滤出4000个文章样本中随机抽取出15个代表性文章集. 文章的篇幅被限制在50至250个字之间,以确保足够的语言差异,同时保持人类注释的可行性。 简化参考书目是由爱沙尼亚本地语言学家按照结构化说明准则独立撰写的。 这些简化是在没有接触模型产出的情况下产生的,以避免评价中的偏见。

blocks.en: 4.2 Model Access and Configuration
blocks.zh: 4.2 模式访问和配置

blocks.en: All large language models were accessed via the OpenRouter API. 1 1 1 https://openrouter.ai Standard parameters were used across models, including a temperature of 0.7 and top-p of 0.9, unless otherwise noted. Token limits were adjusted according to each model’s capabilities, with higher limits used for models such as Claude-3.5 that support extended context windows. Requests were submitted in OpenAI-compatible chat format using authenticated API calls.
blocks.zh: 所有大型语言模型都通过OpenRouter API访问。 除非另有说明,所有模型都采用了标准参数,包括0.7和0.9的温度。 根据每个模型的能力调整了Token限制,对支持扩展上下文窗口的Claude-3.5等模型使用更高的限制. 请求是以与OpenAI兼容的聊天格式提交的,使用了经认证的API调用.

blocks.en: 4.3 Prompt Execution Pipelines
blocks.zh: 4.3 迅速执行管道

blocks.en: Three prompting strategies were implemented to support different levels of control over the simplification process: Single-Pass, Pipeline-Only, and Pipeline-Guideline. Each strategy involved a distinct series of interactions with the LLMs, ranging from a single task-oriented instruction to multi-agent workflows. Agent roles were defined using natural language instructions to emulate domain-specific simplification behavior. In the Pipeline-Guideline strategy, an initial guideline-generating agent was added to establish simplification objectives before subsequent content transformation.
blocks.zh: 实施了三个催化战略,以支持对简化过程的不同程度的控制:单管-单管-单管-和管线-导管. 每项战略都涉及与有限责任方案的一系列独特的互动,从单一的任务导向指示到多代理工作流程。 代理角色被用自然语言指令来模拟特定域的简化行为来定义. 在管道-指南战略中,增加了一个初步的生成指导剂,以便在随后的内容转换之前确定简化目标.

blocks.en: 4.4 Software Environment
blocks.zh: 4.4 软件环境

blocks.en: All experiments were conducted in a Python 3.11 environment. Standard open-source libraries were used for API communication, text processing, and evaluation. These included packages for computing readability (e.g., FKGL), semantic similarity (e.g., BERTScore), and coherence (e.g., sentence embeddings). Sentence segmentation and discourse marker identification were conducted using Estonian-specific NLP tools. Evaluation and model interaction were performed on local hardware with GPU support.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都是在Python 3.11的环境中进行的. 标准开源库被用于API通信,文本处理和评价. 其中包括计算可读性(如FKGL),语义相似性(如BERTScore)和一致性(如句子嵌入)的软件包. 利用爱沙尼亚特有的NLP工具进行了判刑分解和话语标记识别。 在GPU的支持下,在当地硬件上进行了评价和模型互动。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: To assess the effectiveness of the evaluated models and prompting strategies, both automatic and manual evaluations were conducted.
blocks.zh: 为了评估评价模型的有效性并促使制定战略,进行了自动和人工评价。

blocks.en: 5.1 Automatic Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.1 自动评价

blocks.en: Automatic evaluation was conducted using metrics that assess surface-level rewriting quality and discourse-level textual properties. The evaluation covers multiple LLMs’ prompting strategies (Single-Pass Prompting, Pipeline-Only, and Pipeline-Guideline).
blocks.zh: 使用评估地表层重写质量和语句层文本属性的衡量标准进行了自动评价。 评估涵盖多个LLMs的促动策略(单管快活、管线-独活和管线-导线).

blocks.en: The following metrics were used to quantify readability, semantic preservation, and lexical simplification:
blocks.zh: 以下衡量标准用于量化可读性、语义保全和词汇简化:

blocks.en: • FKGL Kincaid et al. (1975) estimates the U.S. school grade level required to understand a text, based on average sentence length and syllable count per word. Lower scores indicate simpler, more readable output. As a non-reference metric, FKGL is widely used in text simplification to assess surface-level readability, especially when gold-standard references are unavailable. Despite its simplicity and interpretability, FKGL can be gamed and does not capture meaning preservation or grammaticality. In this study, FKGL is used to complement semantic and structural metrics, and was computed using the textstat package. • BERTScore Zhang et al. (2019) measures semantic similarity between texts by comparing contextualized token embeddings from BERT. The measure is well-suited for evaluating document-level simplifications, where rephrasing and structural changes are common. Unlike surface-level metrics such as BLEU, BERT-S captures meaning preservation more effectively, aligning closely with human judgments. This study computed BERT-S using the official bert_score package. 2 2 2 https://github.com/Tiiiger/bert_score • Document-SARI (D-SARI) Sun et al. (2021) extends the sentence-level SARI metric Xu et al. (2016) to evaluate simplification quality at the document level. It operates by computing sentence-wise SARI scores, assessing additions and deletions, keeping words between system output, source, and reference, and then aggregating these across documents. Unlike traditional n-gram metrics, D-SARI captures the simplification process by rewarding informative insertions and deletions while penalizing unnecessary retention.
blocks.zh: • FKGL Kincaid等(1975年)根据平均句子长度和每个字的音节计数,估计了解文字所需的美国学分水平。 较低的分数表示更简单,更可读取的输出. 作为一种非参考性衡量标准,FKGL被广泛用于文本简化,以评估地表可读性,特别是在黄金标准参考不可用的情况下. 尽管FKGL简单而可解释,但它可以被游戏并不会捕捉到"保存"或"语法"的意思. 在这项研究中,FKGL被用于补充语义和结构度量,是使用文本统计软件包计算的。 • BERTScore Zhang等(2019年)通过比较BERT的上下文符号嵌入,衡量文本之间的语义相似性。 该措施非常适合评价文件层面的简化,因为重写和结构变化很常见。 与BLEU等地表级度量衡不同,BERT-S捕捉更能有效保存,与人类判断紧密相通. 这项研究使用正式的bet_score软件包计算BERT-S。 2 2 2 https://github.com/Tiiger/bert_score 文档-SARI(D-SARI) Sun等人(2021年)将句子级SARI 度量衡Xu等人(2016年)扩展为评估文件级的简化质量. 它通过计算句法 SARI 分数,评估增删,将单词保留在系统输出,源和引用之间,然后在文档中汇总. 与传统的正克度量法不同,D-SARI通过奖励信息性插入和删除,同时惩罚不必要的保留来捕捉简化过程.

blocks.en: To complement surface-level evaluation, two custom metrics were implemented to capture the simplified texts’ discourse coherence and structural consistency. These metrics assess properties not reflected in traditional word or sentence-level scores.
blocks.zh: 为了补充表面评价,实施了两个定制度量标准,以掌握简化文本的用语一致性和结构一致性。 这些度量衡评估了传统词或句子级别分数中没有反映的属性.

blocks.en: • Coherence was assessed by computing the average pairwise cosine similarity between adjacent sentence embeddings, using a multilingual Sentence-BERT model Reimers and Gurevych (2019) . This embedding-based approach quantifies the logical flow between consecutive sentences, with higher values indicating stronger local Coherence. We report both the mean similarity ( coherence_mu ) and its variability ( coherence_std ). • Discourse Marker Preservation was measured as the proportion of discourse markers retained between the original and simplified versions. Markers were identified using a curated Estonian inventory based on established discourse relation taxonomies Prasad et al. (2008) . This metric reflects the degree to which discourse structure is preserved in the output. Both average preservation rate and standard deviation ( discourse_preservation , discourse_std ) are reported.
blocks.zh: • 通过计算相邻句子嵌入体之间的平均对偶余弦相近性,使用多语种句子-BERT模型Reimers和Gurevych(2019年)来评估一致性。 这种基于嵌入的方法将相继句子之间的逻辑流量化,更高的值表明更强的局部一致性. 我们既报告平均相似性(一致性-mu),也报告其可变性(一致性-std)。 分解标记保存被测量为在正版和简化版之间保留的分解标记的比例. 根据既定的论述关系分类法确定标记。 这个衡量标准反映了在产出中话语结构被保留到何种程度. 平均保全率和标准偏差(论语-保留-,论语-std)均被报告.

blocks.en: Table 1 reveals important trends across LLMs and prompting strategies. First, lower FKGL scores in the Single-Pass setting (SP) indicate higher textual simplicity; however, this often coincides with reduced BERT-S and D-SARI scores, highlighting a trade-off between simplicity and meaning preservation. In contrast, the Pipeline-Only (PO) and Pipeline-Guideline (PG) strategies yield higher BERT-S values, suggesting better retention of semantic content. D-SARI scores, which reward aligned addition, deletion, and retention operations, also tend to be higher for PO, indicating more controlled structural simplifications.
blocks.zh: 表1显示各地方政府和地方政府的重要趋势以及推动战略。 首先,Single-Pass设置(SP)中FKGL分数较低,表示文字更简洁;然而,这往往与BERT-S和D-SARI分数减少相吻合,凸显出简洁和意义保存之间的取舍. 相形之下,管道-Only(PO)和管道-指南(PG)战略产生较高的BERT-S值,建议更好地保留语义内容. D-SARI分数奖励了对齐的添加,删除,和保留操作,PO的分数也往往较高,表明更有控制的结构简化.

blocks.en: Table 1: Automatic evaluation results for each LLM and prompting strategy. SP = Single-Pass Prompting, PO = Pipeline-Only, PG = Pipeline-Guideline. Metrics: FKGL (readability), BERT-S (semantic similarity), D-SARI (simplification operations), Coherence (cosine similarity of adjacent sentences), Discourse (marker preservation). The strategies that were manually evaluated are indicated in gray for clarity.
blocks.zh: 表1:每个LLM的自动评价结果和提示策略. SP=单管提示,PO=管线-单管提示,PG=管线-导线. 计量:FKGL(可读性),BERT-S(语义相近),D-SARI(简化操作),一致性(相邻句子的同理相近),发售(标记保存). 人工评估的战略以灰色表示,以明确无误。

blocks.en: Discourse-level metrics provide deeper insights. Coherence is measured by pairwise cosine similarity of adjacent sentence embeddings, while Discourse evaluates the preservation of discourse markers. Both metrics tend to show a consistent advantage for the PG strategy. Notably, GPT-4.1 and LLaMA-3.3 achieve the highest coherence scores (0.413 and 0.429), while Gemini-2.0 and Qwen-2.5 maintain strong performance across both discourse and coherence dimensions. In contrast, Claude-3.5 shows lower discourse preservation under PG (0.194), suggesting difficulties maintaining explicit structural cues despite improved coherence.
blocks.zh: 论述层面的衡量标准提供了更深入的见解。 一致性通过相邻句子嵌入相邻的对等同性来测量,而"论语"则评价了话语标记的保存. 这两个衡量标准都倾向于对PG战略表现出一贯的优势. 值得注意的是,GPT-4.1和LLaMA-3.3取得了最高一致性分数(0.413和0.429),而双子座2.0和Quen-2.5则在讨论和一致性方面保持了强劲的业绩。 与此相反,克洛德-3.5在PG(0.194)下的论述保留率较低,这表明尽管一致性有所改善,仍难以保持明确的结构提示。

blocks.en: GPT-4.1 performs strongly in SP and PO settings, especially in terms of semantic coherence and discourse preservation. However, it underperforms in the PG setting, where structural fidelity and simplification operations degrade significantly. Qwen-2.5 , while consistent in discourse-related scores, lags slightly in semantic similarity and grammaticality compared to top-performing models like Gemini-2.0 and LLaMA-3.3 .
blocks.zh: GPT-4.1在SP和PO环境中表现强劲,特别是在语义上的一致性和话语保存方面. 然而,它在PG环境中表现不佳,结构忠诚和简化操作显著地下降。 Quen-2.5 与双子座-2.0和LLaMA-3.3等顶级表现模式相比,虽然在与话语相关的分数上是一致的,但在语义相似性和语法上稍有滞后.

blocks.en: These results show that the prompting strategy can significantly affect output quality, sometimes more than the LLM architecture.
blocks.zh: 这些结果显示,催化策略可以显著地影响出产质量,有时比LLM架构还要多.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Discourse preservation and coherence scores across LLMs using the Pipeline-Guideline prompting strategy.
blocks.zh: 图 1: 利用管道-指南促进战略,在LLMs中进行论文保存和一致性评分。

blocks.en: Figure 1 complements Table 1 by providing a visual comparison of discourse-level performance under the Pipeline-Guideline (PG) strategy. Notably, LLaMA-3.3 and GPT-4.1 achieve the highest coherence scores, suggesting strong logical flow and sentence connectivity in their simplified outputs. In terms of discourse marker preservation, Gemini-2.0 outperforms the other models, reflecting its strength in retaining explicit textual cues such as connectives and transitions.
blocks.zh: 图1 表1提供了管道-指南(PG)战略下话语层次表现的直观比较. 值得注意的是,LLaMA-3.3和GPT-4.1取得了最高的连贯性分数,表明在简化产出中,逻辑流动和句子连接很强。 在话语标记保存方面,双子座-2.0优于其他模型,反映了其在保留连接和过渡等明确文字提示方面的实力.

blocks.en: The contrast between coherence and discourse scores highlights distinct model-specific tendencies. For instance, Claude-3.5 demonstrates relatively low discourse marker preservation despite achieving moderate coherence, indicating that while it produces fluent text, it often omits explicit structural anchors. In contrast, Gemini-2.0 maintains a strong balance between semantic flow and discourse structure, performing consistently across both dimensions. Qwen-2.5 shows a different pattern: it preserves surface-level discourse markers reasonably well but struggles with coherence, suggesting difficulties in maintaining fluid progression between sentences.
blocks.zh: 一致性和讨论分数之间的对比突出了不同的模式特定趋势。 例如,克洛德-3.5尽管实现了适度的连贯性,但仍显示出相对较低的话语标记保存,这表明虽然它能产生流利的文本,但往往省略了明确的结构锚. 相形之下,双子座-2.0在语义流与语义结构之间保持了很强的平衡,在两个维度上都一致地表现. Quen-2.5呈现出不同的模式:它保持了表面水平的语境标记,但与一致性相抗衡,说明句子之间难以保持流畅的进取.

blocks.en: These findings underscore the importance of evaluating implicit and explicit discourse features in simplification outputs. While coherence captures the internal semantic continuity of the text, discourse marker preservation offers a complementary perspective on structural fidelity.
blocks.zh: 这些结论强调,必须评价简化产出中隐含和明确的论述特征。 虽然一致性能反映案文的内部语义连续性,但言语标记保存提供了对结构忠诚性的补充视角。

blocks.en: It also motivates the manual evaluation that follows.
blocks.zh: 它还促使下文的人工评价。

blocks.en: 5.2 Manual Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.2 人工评价

blocks.en: Based on the automatic evaluation results, we selected three top-performing models for manual assessment: Gemini-2.0 , Qwen-2.5 , and LLaMA-3.3 . These models exhibited the highest overall performance in terms of fluency, meaning preservation, and readability.
blocks.zh: 根据自动评价结果,我们为人工评估选择了三种表现最好的模式:双子座2.0、Quen-2.5和LLaMA-3.3。 这些模型在流利性、保存性和可读性方面表现出最高的总体性能。

blocks.en: After an initial qualitative analysis of outputs from all prompting strategies, the manual evaluation focused exclusively on the Pipeline-Only approach. This method consistently yielded the most coherent and structurally sound document-level simplifications. In contrast, though effective at breaking down complex content, the Pipeline-Guideline strategy often led to over-segmentation and overly verbose explanatory additions.
blocks.zh: 在对所有促进性战略的产出进行初步定性分析后,手工评价完全侧重于管道-唯一办法。 这种方法始终产生最连贯和结构上最健全的文件简化。 相形之下,管道-指南战略虽然有效地打破了复杂的内容,但往往导致过于分化和过于动词性的解释性添加.

blocks.en: Manual evaluation aimed to assess the quality of the simplified Estonian texts along three core dimensions:
blocks.zh: 手册评价旨在按照三个核心方面评估爱沙尼亚简化文本的质量:

blocks.en: • Grammaticality : This dimension evaluates whether the simplified text uses correct case forms, verb conjugations, word order, and punctuation. It reflects the overall grammatical integrity and naturalness of the output. • Meaning Preservation : This criterion assesses how accurately the simplified version conveys the essential information and intent of the original text. It ensures that no critical details are omitted, distorted, or replaced by unwarranted additions that alter the intended meaning. • Simplicity : This dimension examines how much lexical and syntactic complexity has been reduced. Simplicity is achieved through more precise vocabulary, shorter and more manageable sentences, and improved structural organization. Annotators also considered whether document-level simplification operations were effectively applied.
blocks.zh: • 语法: 这个维度评价了简化文本是否使用正确的大小写表,动词相和,词序相和相和相通相. 它反映了输出的整体语法完整性和自然性. • 保护的含义: 这一标准评估了简化版本如何准确传达出原始文本的基本信息和意图。 它确保不遗漏、歪曲或取而代之的是改变原意的不必要的添加。 • 简洁性:这一方面审查词汇和综合的复杂性已减少多少。 简化是通过更精确的词汇,更短更可管理的句子,以及更好的结构组织来实现的. 注释者还考虑了文件一级的简化业务是否得到有效运用。

blocks.zh: 语法: 这个维度评价了简化文本是否使用正确的大小写表,动词相和,词序相和相和相通相. 它反映了输出的整体语法完整性和自然性.

Simplicity is achieved through more precise vocabulary, shorter and more manageable sentences, and improved structural organization. Annotators also considered whether document-level simplification operations were effectively applied.
blocks.zh: 简单化 : 这一层面审视了词汇和综合的复杂性已减少多少。 简化是通过更精确的词汇,更短更可管理的句子,以及更好的结构组织来实现的. 注释者还考虑了文件一级的简化业务是否得到有效实施。

blocks.en: Two native Estonian speakers with expertise in linguistics conducted the annotation. Before beginning the main evaluation, the annotators held a calibration session to ensure consistency. This meeting clarified the evaluation criteria, resolved ambiguities in interpretation, and aligned their use of the 5-point Likert scale. The full annotation guidelines used during this process are publicly available in our repository (see Section 7 ).
blocks.zh: 两名具有语言学专门知识的爱沙尼亚本地人作了笔记。 在开始主要评价之前,注释者举行了一次校正会,以确保一致性。 这次会议澄清了评价标准,解决了解释上的模糊之处,并调整了对5分Irikrt比额表的使用。 在这个过程中使用的注释准则全文可在我们的存储处公开查阅(见第7节)。

blocks.en: Both annotators independently rated the same document simplified by each of the three evaluated models to assess reliability. Ratings were collected for grammaticality, meaning preservation, and simplicity using a 5-point Likert scale. The inter-annotator agreement was measured using quadratic-weighted Cohen’s κ \kappa Cohen (1968) , which accounts for ordinal rating differences.
blocks.zh: 两名注释员都对同一文件进行独立评分,由三个评价模型中的每一模型简化,以评估可靠性。 收集的评分用于语法,意思是保存,以及使用5分相像尺度的简单. 校对:Soup

blocks.en: The agreement was substantial across all three dimensions. The highest agreement was observed for Meaning Preservation ( κ = 0.73 \kappa=0.73 ), followed by Grammaticality and Simplicity (both at κ = 0.67 \kappa=0.67 ). These values confirm the consistency of the annotation protocol and support the reliability of the following evaluation results.
blocks.zh: 该协议涉及所有三个方面。 对含义保全(0.73\kappa=0.73)表示最高一致,其次是语法和简约(均为0.67\kappa=0.67)。 这些数值证实了注释协议的一致性,并支持以下评价结果的可靠性.

blocks.en: Following this reliability phase, the annotators independently evaluated four additional articles each, thus producing nine annotated documents.
blocks.zh: 在这一可靠性阶段之后,注释员独立评价了每篇另外四篇文章,从而产生了九篇附加说明的文件.

blocks.en: Table 2 shows clear differences in how the three evaluated models performed. Gemini-2.0 scored the highest in all areas. LLaMA-3.3 was close behind, while Qwen-2.5 performed noticeably worse. Figure 2 provides a qualitative comparison of the original input and the simplifications generated by the top-performing models.
blocks.zh: 表2显示三种评价模式的绩效明显不同。 双子座2.0的得分在所有地区都最高. LLaMA-3.3在紧跟后面,而Quen-2.5的表现则明显更糟糕. 图2对原始投入和顶级模型产生的简化进行了定性比较。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Example of text simplification outputs from different models.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 不同模型的文本简化产出实例。

blocks.en: Table 2: Manual evaluation results for three top-performing models. Scores are averaged across evaluated articles using a 5-point Likert scale (1 = Very Poor, 5 = Excellent).
blocks.zh: 表2:三个业绩最佳模式的手工评价结果。 使用5分的Irikrt分数(1=非常差,5=极好),在被评价文章中平均得分.

blocks.en: Gemini-2.0 consistently delivered fluent, coherent, and well-structured simplifications annotators found much easier to understand than the originals. In several cases, it earned perfect scores across all evaluation dimensions. While it occasionally made minor grammatical errors, such as incorrect case endings, these did not interfere with readability or meaning. The model preserved essential information and avoided distortions. Although it sometimes chose slightly off-target words, these issues were rare and did not impact the overall quality. As shown in Figure 2 , the model substantially shortens the original sentence by removing less essential details (e.g., references to other languages) and splitting the content into two sentences. These results suggest that Gemini-2.0 handles Estonian document-level simplification effectively.
blocks.zh: 双子座-2.0始终如一地提供流利,连贯,结构完善的简化,比出自原作更容易理解. 在一些情况下,它在所有评价方面都获得了完美的分数。 虽然它偶尔会出一些小的语法错误,如不正确的大小写结尾等,但这些并不干扰可读性或意义. 该模型保存了基本信息并避免了扭曲。 虽然它有时选择略为偏离目标的措辞,但这些问题很少见,没有影响整体质量。 如图2所显示,该模型大幅缩短了原有的句子,删除了不太必要的细节(例如参考了其他语言)并分出内容为两句. 这些结果表明,双子座2.0有效处理爱沙尼亚文件一级的简化。

blocks.en: Overall, LLaMA-3.3 performed well. It mostly produced grammatical, well-organized texts with only small omissions of information. Annotators consistently rated its outputs as easier to read than the original versions. While it clarified the text, it often retained unnecessary complexity, such as unnecessary elaborations. In addition, the model introduced slight hallucinations and grammatical errors. Figure 2 illustrates that the model introduces a lexical error by changing entsefaliit to encefaliit , which appears to be a mixture of the Estonian term entsefaliit and its Latin/English counterpart encephalitis .
blocks.zh: 总体而言,LLaMA-3.3的业绩良好。 它大多制作了语法上,组织严密的文本,只有少量的遗漏信息. 注释员们一贯将其产出评为比原文更容易阅读。 虽然它澄清了案文,但往往保留了不必要的复杂性,例如不必要的阐述。 此外,该模型引入了轻微的幻觉和语法错误. 图2显示,该模型引入了一种词法错误,将词源改为词源词,这似乎是爱沙尼亚语词词词源词源词源词和拉丁/英语对应词词源词源词源词源词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词

blocks.en: In contrast, Qwen-2.5 performed poorly across all evaluation dimensions. It often produced texts with grammatical errors, including incorrect case endings, fragmented sentences, and frequent misspellings. Annotators also observed significant meaning distortions, such as hallucinated content and omissions of essential information. While the model attempted various simplification strategies, its lack of grammatical control and weak alignment with the source text made the outputs difficult to follow. Figure 2 also highlights lexical errors in the model output, including the non-existent words üleloomik and survekahju , which also diverge the meaning of the text. In general, the simplified versions were more confusing than the originals. The model has limited Estonian support and underscores the challenges of adapting multilingual models to morphologically rich, low-resource languages.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,Quen-2.5在所有评价方面表现不佳。 它经常产生有语法错误的文本,包括错误的大小写结尾,零碎的句子,以及频繁的错拼. 注释者还观察到重大意义扭曲,如幻觉内容和基本信息的遗漏等. 虽然该模型尝试了各种简化战略,但其缺乏语法控制和与出处文本不一致,使得产出难以遵循。 图2还突出了模型输出中的词汇错误,包括不存在的"üleloomik"和" survekahju"等词,它们也使文本的含义相去甚远. 一般来说,简化版比正版更混乱. 该模式限制了爱沙尼亚的支持,并突出了使多语种模式适应形态上丰富而资源少的语言的挑战。

blocks.en: The manual evaluation confirms that model performance in document-level simplification is highly variable. While models like Gemini-2.0 and LLaMA-3.3 produce near-native fluency and maintain semantic fidelity, others such as Qwen-2.5 exhibit critical deficiencies. These findings underscore the importance of careful evaluation when deploying LLMs for complex language processing tasks in low-resource settings.
blocks.zh: 人工评价证实,文件一级简化的模型性能变化很大。 虽然双子座2.0和LLaMA-3.3等模型产生近亲流并保持语义忠诚,而其他模型如Quen-2.5则显示出了严重缺陷. 这些调查结果突出表明,在低资源环境下部署复杂的语言处理任务时,认真评价的重要性。

blocks.en: The results of the manual evaluation align closely with some automatic metrics for the Pipeline-Only strategy, particularly for the Gemini-2.0 and LLaMA-3.3 models. Gemini-2.0 received the highest average manual score (4.79), consistent with its strong performance in BERTScore (0.887) and D-SARI (0.274), indicating high semantic fidelity and effective simplification operations. LLaMA-3.3 ranked second in manual evaluation (4.17) and also ranked second in automatic evaluation (BERTScore 0.883, D-SARI 0.265), though annotators noted a slightly conservative simplification style. In contrast, Qwen-2.5 , which scored the lowest in manual evaluation (1.75), also showed weaker automatic performance under PO, with the lowest BERTScore (0.880) and only moderate D-SARI (0.271).
blocks.zh: 人工评价的结果与管道-独行战略,特别是双子座2.0和LLaMA-3.3模式的一些自动衡量标准密切相关。 双子座2.0获得最高的手动平均分(4.79分),这与它在BERTScore(0.887分)和D-SARI(0.274分)的强效表现一致,表明语义忠诚度高并有效简化操作. LLaMA-3.3在人工评价中排名第二(4.17),在自动评价中也排名第二(BERTScore 0.883,D-SARI 0.265),虽然注释者注意到一种略为保守的简化风格. 相形之下,在手动评价中得分最低(1.75分)的Quen-2.5也显示PO下的自动性能较弱,其中BERTScore最低(0.880分),而只有中度D-SARI(0.271分).

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This study investigated two research questions: RQ1: which out-of-the-box large language models are most effective for document-level simplification in Estonian, and RQ2: whether automatic metrics alone can reliably identify the best-performing model.
blocks.zh: 这项研究调查了两个研究问题:RQ1:哪个出盒的大型语言模型对爱沙尼亚语的文档级别简化最为有效;RQ2:单靠自动度量标准能否可靠地识别出最优秀的模型.

blocks.en: Across five instruction-tuned LLMs and three prompting strategies, the results show that Gemini-2.0 and LLaMA-3.3 are the most effective models for document-level simplification in Estonian. Both produce fluent outputs with strong meaning preservation, and their performance remains robust across evaluation dimensions. By contrast, Qwen-2.5 frequently introduced grammatical errors and meaning distortions, highlighting that multilingual coverage does not guarantee reliable performance in morphologically rich, low-resource settings.
blocks.zh: 在5个指导调整的LLM和3个促进战略中,结果显示双子座2.0和LLaMA-3.3是爱沙尼亚文件一级简化的最有效模式。 两者都能够产生具有强烈意义的流利产出,其业绩在评价层面依然强劲。 相形之下,Quen-2.5经常引入语法错误和意义扭曲,强调多语种覆盖并不能保证在形态丰富,资源低的环境下的可靠性能.

blocks.en: For RQ2 , automatic metrics (FKGL, BERTScore, D-SARI) provided useful signals for broad model comparisons, and the proposed discourse-aware measures (sentence-embedding coherence and discourse marker preservation) offered complementary evidence about document structure. However, the alignment between automatic metrics and human judgment was only partial. Manual evaluation was necessary to capture qualitative distinctions that matter at the document level, including local coherence, referential clarity, and the usability of the simplified text as a whole. In addition, the qualitative inspection that motivated focusing on the Pipeline-Only strategy reinforces that prompt design decisions for document-level simplification benefit from human-in-the-loop assessment.
blocks.zh: 就RQ2而言,自动衡量标准(FKGL、BERTScore、D-SARI)为广泛的模型比较提供了有用的信号,拟议的有言论意识的衡量标准(判决-嵌入式一致性和言论标记保存)为文件结构提供了补充证据。 然而,自动衡量标准与人类判断之间的一致只是部分的。 有必要进行人工评估,以掌握文件一级重要的定性区别,包括地方一致性、优惠清晰度以及整个简化文本的可用性。 此外,注重管道-仅管战略的定性检查强化了迅速作出文件一级简化的设计决定受益于即时评估。

blocks.en: Overall, the findings demonstrate that multilingual LLMs can support document-level simplification in Estonian, but achieving reliable quality requires careful choices in both prompting strategy and evaluation methodology. All resources needed to reproduce the experiments are made publicly available (Section 7 ).
blocks.zh: 总的来说,调查结果表明,多种语文的有限责任管理课程可以支持爱沙尼亚文的文件一级简化,但要达到可靠的质量,就需要在推动战略和评价方法方面作出认真的选择。 复制实验所需的一切资源都公开(第7节)。

blocks.en: 7 Reproducibility
blocks.zh: 7 可复制性

blocks.en: To ensure transparency and enable reproducibility, we share the full codebase, evaluation scripts, prompt templates, and model outputs used in our experiments. The repository includes:
blocks.zh: 为了确保透明度和可复制性,我们分享我们实验中使用的完整编码库、评价脚本、即时模板和模型产出。 资料库包括:

blocks.en:

blocks.en: 8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en: Several limitations should be considered when interpreting these findings. First, the manual evaluation was conducted on a small set of documents, which constrains the statistical strength of conclusions about fine-grained differences between models and prompting strategies. Second, the evaluation data consists of Estonian Wikipedia articles; while this enables controlled experimentation, it may not reflect the linguistic variability and pragmatic demands of other genres (e.g., public service communication, health information, or educational materials). Third, our models were evaluated in an out-of-the-box setting via a shared API interface; this design supports comparability, but it does not examine whether Estonian-specific adaptation (e.g., fine-tuning, terminology constraints, or decoding control) could substantially change the ranking of open-access models. Finally, the proposed discourse-aware automatic metrics capture only a subset of document-level quality: they quantify local semantic continuity and the preservation of explicit discourse markers, but they do not fully model global discourse structure, factual consistency, or the appropriateness of content additions and deletions.
blocks.zh: 在解释这些调查结果时应考虑若干限制。 首先,手工评估是针对一套小文件进行的,这限制了关于模型之间细微差别的结论的统计力量,也限制了促进战略。 其次,评价数据由爱沙尼亚维基百科的文章组成;虽然这可以进行有控制的实验,但可能无法反映其他流派(如公共服务通信,卫生信息,或教育材料)的语言可变性和务实需求. 第三,通过共享的API接口,我们的模型在一个外框设置中得到了评价;这种设计支持可比性,但是它没有审查爱沙尼亚特有的适应(如微调,名词限制,或解码控制)是否能够实质性地改变开放存取模型的排名. 最后,拟议的话语感知自动衡量标准只捕捉了文件级别质量的子集:它们量化了当地语义的连续性并保留了明确的话语标记,但它们并没有完全模拟全球话语结构,事实一致性,或者内容添加和删除的适当性.
